'''Zappur''' is a [[Lightning]] type Support [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Electroar]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Zappur always tries to look tough. Once spent an entire afternoon practicing the most ferocious roar possible, only to get handed a piece of candy with a passing 'Awwww.'"

Zappur is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, yellow lion cub with a lightning bolt shaped tail. It has large orangeish eyebrows, pink blush, and a whiteish underbelly. 

Zappur's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with off-white.

== Evolution Trial ==
Zappur's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Electroar]] you need to complete the following task:
* Use Zappur to clear 20 stages. Show 'em who's boss!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "A baboon once lifted Zappur up as a baby. Now there's a dangerous uncle out there."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Zappur isn't particularly strong in combat, yet always stands tall and tries to look fierce, growling at enemies adorably."

==Strategy==
[[File:Zappur Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Zappur's attack range]]
A simple Lightning tank, it can knock back Zobos a short distance, helping to slow down the Zobos' progress and group up multiple Zobos together. Place in front for max effectiveness. 
{{clear|left}}
